pages.text:
Bulk item storage in riveted steel: 20 slots a block.
# One store
Item Reservoirs placed together form one store when they make a solid box: a cross-section 1 to 3 blocks wide and tall, and a length up to 3 times its width, along any axis. The rims run round its outer edges and a band wraps each end, so a long store reads as one container.
- Blocks that don't make a valid box stay separate stores, each with rims and bands of its own.
- Each block adds its slots to the store.

# Using it
Any block opens the whole store: a scrolling grid of its slots with a search box (type a name, or @mod). Hoppers, Item Conduits and other mods' item handlers take and give items through any block, and a comparator reads how full it is.
# Breaking one
A broken block spills its share of the items, like a chest. Pick it up with the Wrench's Dismantle to keep them on the item.
